items.source: Exposes the values of properties configured through CodecConfigurer.defaultCodecs() that are applied to default codecs. The main purpose of this interface is to provide access to them so they can also be applied to custom codecs if needed.
items.translation: 暴露通过 `CodecConfigurer.defaultCodecs()` 配置并应用于默认编解码器的属性值。此接口的主要目的是提供对这些属性的访问，以便在需要时也可将它们应用于自定义编解码器。

items.source:
Get the configured limit on the number of bytes that can be buffered whenever
the input stream needs to be aggregated.
items.translation: 获取输入流需要聚合时，可缓冲的字节数的配置限制。

items.source:
Whether to log form data at DEBUG level, and headers at TRACE level.
Both may contain sensitive information.
items.translation: 是否在 DEBUG 级别记录表单数据，在 TRACE 级别记录标头。两者都可能包含敏感信息。
